display_name: Ranna, Jewel of the Jain Poets
one_line: 10th‑century Jain court poet of Karnataka, moving through the Kannada-speaking courts that nurtured Pampa, Ponna and Ranna.

appearance.age_look: Looks about 28–32, slim scholarly build with slightly rounded shoulders from long hours of writing.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown Karnataka complexion, fine straight nose, gentle jawline, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm large anime-style eyes with a steady contemplative gaze, default expression a serene half-smile of quiet confidence.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-centre, combed back and tied into a small low knot at the back of the head; a thin, dark cotton headband (like a narrow patka) wraps around the forehead, knotted discreetly at the back, keeping hair tidy.
appearance.costume: Simple yet dignified 10th‑century Jain court scholar attire: a long, ankle-length off‑white cotton uttariya/draped upper cloth wrapped over both shoulders and across the chest like a shawl, covering a light cream knee-length angavastra-style tunic with long fitted sleeves, paired with plain unpleated off‑white cotton lower wrap (dhoti-style veshti) tied at the waist and falling to the ankles; a narrow woven waist-band in muted maroon and gold secures the wrap; feet in brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—one small copper-gold toned ear stud in each ear and a simple dark thread bracelet on the right wrist; no ostentatious ornaments, garments slightly worn but clean and neatly arranged.
appearance.signature: A dark wooden palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with thin cord and a slender iron stylus tucked through the knot, usually cradled in his left arm while his right hand gestures as if reciting.

ref_desc: Ranna is a slim, early‑30s Jain court poet with medium‑brown skin, short beard, black hair tied in a low knot with a dark headband, wearing off‑white draped cotton garments with a muted maroon waist-band and brown sandals, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with iron stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a 10th‑century Jain court poet named Ranna: a slim early-thirties man with medium-brown Karnataka complexion, oval face, straight nose, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and large calm eyes with a serene half-smile. His thick black hair is parted slightly off-centre, combed back, and tied into a small low knot at the back of his head, held in place by a thin dark cotton headband wrapped around his forehead. He wears era-accurate, modest 10th‑century Karnataka Jain scholar clothing: an ankle-length off‑white cotton lower wrap (dhoti-style) tied at the waist, a light cream long-sleeved tunic reaching to the knees, and a long off‑white cotton upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across his chest like a shawl, all plain-woven and unornamented, slightly worn but clean and neatly arranged. A narrow muted maroon and gold woven waist-band secures the wrap at his waist, and he has brown leather sandals on his feet. Jewellery is minimal: a small copper-gold toned ear stud in each ear and a simple dark thread bracelet on his right wrist, emphasising his restrained Jain aesthetic. His signature prop is a dark wooden palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with thin cord, with a slender iron stylus tucked through the knot, which he cradles in his left arm while his right hand is shown in a gentle, expressive reciting gesture. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, cream, muted maroon, brown, and black, and present front, side, and back views plus a close-up of his face and the manuscript bundle, keeping the overall look dignified, historically grounded, and consistently repeatable.
